## ⚠️ If you have Little Lotus 1.0: uninstall it first

The key that signed 1.0 was lost, so 1.1 is signed with a new one, and Android won't install it over 1.0. **Uninstall Little Lotus 1.0, then install 1.1.** Your stars and settings from 1.0 will be reset. Sorry for the trouble; future updates will install normally over 1.1.

**Install:** on your Android phone (Android 7 or newer), tap **LittleLotus.apk** below, open the downloaded file, and allow your browser to install apps if asked.

## New: Play together
- One quiz for a whole room, on one big screen
- Players answer on their own phones by scanning a code (no app needed on their phones), in teams with printed A, B, C, D cards, or both, with one scoreboard
- Faster right answers on phones score more; scores after each question and a podium at the end
- Works over this phone's Wi-Fi or hotspot; nothing goes over the internet

## Also
- Little Lotus is now shown as an initiative of Restore Shri Ganesha
- Talks with no known date now say "Date unknown" instead of 1 January 1970

The app now asks for network access, which Play together needs for players in the same room. It still collects no data ([privacy policy](https://sahajbalgunde.com/little-lotus-privacy/)).

**Full list of changes:** #1, #2, #3
